title: A command registered a netsh helper DLL
detail: netsh ran "add helper", which registers a DLL that netsh loads every time it starts.
impact: A helper DLL runs inside netsh with the rights of whoever starts it, often an administrator or SYSTEM. It is a known way to stay on a host.
focus: Read the command line for the DLL's path, then check that file: its signer, when it was created, and who ran the command. Look under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\NetSh for the helper it left.
notes: High, not critical: some network and VPN software installs a helper, usually through the registry rather than this command.

tests.note: listing the helpers, which changes nothing
